tool.description: DeliverAuditEvents appends one range of the journal's audit records to the warehouse audit storage: the operation module-runtime calls after reading the range through ReadJournal. It is an operation, not a sweep. It takes each record's organization from the journal row and never from the caller, emits no audit of its own, and commits one receipt per range under the installation's tenant; delivery is at least once, and every read of the storage returns each entry once by id. Its receipt is read back through LookupDeliverAuditEvents.
tool.name: DeliverAuditEvents
